## Docs review checklist

### Content

- [ ] Each page covers one task or one concept.
- [ ] Steps are numbered, and each step states its expected result.
- [ ] Every code sample runs against the Prism mock.
- [ ] Examples use fictional names only. No real people, clubs, or companies.
- [ ] Facts match the OpenAPI spec. The reference is generated, not edited by hand.

### Style

- [ ] US English, second person, active voice, present tense.
- [ ] Headings use sentence case.
- [ ] No marketing language or filler.
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes used as punctuation.
- [ ] No positional references such as "above" or "below". Cross-references are links.

### Checks

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally.
- [ ] CI is green (Vale, Spectral, links, samples, build).
- [ ] I reviewed the rendered pages in the Vercel preview.
